title: stream_frame
description: One frame of a live screen stream, sent only on the Vision channel while a session is approved. The server forwards it unchanged to the admin panels that hold an open remote-control session for this device and drops it when there is none. The panel files the frame under `hw_id`, so it must be the agent's own ID.

image.description: Base64 JPEG (the Windows tray captures at 75 % scale).

hw_id.description: The agent's own device ID; the panel uses it to place the frame.
